system.description: Pay 2 stress to become a radiant being of crackling energy. While in this mode you ignore all harm penalties (level 4 harm is still lethal), your physical attacks gain potency, and you can push yourself to shoot arcs of electroplasmic lightning. The projection drops at the end of the scene (or pay 2 stress to continue for another scene). When you drop the projection, take the level 2 harm Drained and the GM will tick a clock of their choice (you may resist these consequences).
